strings.zh: 在愤怒湖出现了红色暴鲤龙,{NEWLINE}那是非常稀有的精灵哦,{CLEAR}您如果有时间的话也去看看吧。
strings.en: A red Gyarados has appeared at the{NEWLINE}Lake of Rage. It’s a very rare Pokémon.{CLEAR}If you have time, go and see it.

strings.zh: 虽然红色暴鲤龙不见了,{NEWLINE}但暴雨的愤怒湖和雨后的愤怒湖{CLEAR}依然是卡吉镇的一大景点,{CLEAR}绝对值得您去一看。
strings.en: The red Gyarados is gone, but the Lake{NEWLINE}of Rage in a downpour and after the{CLEAR}rain is still one of Mahogany Town’s{CLEAR}great sights. It’s well worth a visit.

strings.zh: 愤怒湖出现红色暴鲤龙{NEWLINE}属于天降异象,{CLEAR}一定是上天派出了这只精灵{CLEAR}来惩罚我们人类。
strings.en: A red Gyarados appearing at the{NEWLINE}Lake of Rage is an omen from the{CLEAR}heavens. Heaven must have sent{CLEAR}this Pokémon to punish us humans.

strings.zh: 愤怒湖的红色暴鲤龙消失了,{NEWLINE}这说明上天的怒火已经平息,{CLEAR}我们人类终于得救了。
strings.en: The red Gyarados at the Lake of Rage{NEWLINE}is gone. That means heaven’s anger has{CLEAR}calmed. We humans are saved at last.

strings.zh: 我曾经在愤怒湖见到过{NEWLINE}三只飘在空中的精灵。{CLEAR}它们分别顶着一个{CLEAR}黄色、红色和蓝色的帽子。{CLEAR}那是我从来没有见过的种类,{CLEAR}说实话我觉得这三只精灵{CLEAR}可比红色暴鲤龙稀有多了。
strings.en: I once saw three Pokémon{NEWLINE}floating in the air at the Lake{CLEAR}of Rage. They each had a yellow,{CLEAR}red or blue cap on their heads.{SCROLL}I’d never seen that kind before.{NEWLINE}Honestly, I think those three are{CLEAR}way rarer than the red Gyarados.
